Cisco 1000BASE-SX Multimode SFP Module | GLC-SX-MMD

High-Performance 1GE Short-Range Transceiver for Reliable Networking

The Cisco 1000BASE-SX Multimode SFP Module (GLC-SX-MMD) is a high-speed, energy-efficient, and reliable optical transceiver designed for short-range Gigabit Ethernet (1GE) networking. With an 850nm wavelength and LC duplex connector, this hot-swappable module ensures seamless data transmission up to 500 meters over multimode fiber (MMF).

Key Features & Benefits

1GE Short-Range Transceiver – Supports Gigabit Ethernet (1Gbps) speeds with the 1000BASE-SX standard
Multimode Fiber (MMF) Compatibility – Optimized for short-distance data transmission
Wavelength: 850nm – Ensures efficient, high-speed optical communication
LC Duplex Connector – Provides secure, high-quality optical connections
Transmission Distance: Up to 500m – Reliable for enterprise networking and data centers
DOM (Digital Optical Monitoring) Support – Enables real-time monitoring of optical performance
Plug & Play Compatibility – Works with Cisco and other leading brands of routers and switches
Hot-Swappable – Easy installation and replacement without network downtime
Universal Compatibility – Compatible with all major networking brands' SFP ports

Technical Specifications

Model: Cisco GLC-SX-MMD
Standard: 1000BASE-SX
Data Rate: 1Gbps (Gigabit Ethernet)
Wavelength: 850nm
Connector Type: LC Duplex
Fiber Type: Multimode Fiber (MMF)
Transmission Distance: Up to 500 meters
DOM Support: Yes (Monitors signal strength, temperature, and performance)
Hot-Swappable: Yes
Device Compatibility: Works with Cisco and other major networking brands
Condition: Full Fresh
Warranty: 1-Year Manufacturer Warranty

Ideal Applications for Cisco GLC-SX-MMD SFP Module

Enterprise Networks – Provides high-speed connectivity for business-critical applications
Data Centers – Ensures low-latency connections between switches and servers
Campus & Corporate LANs – Reliable for short-range fiber-optic networking
Cloud & Virtualization Environments – Optimized for scalable and efficient network expansion
Service Provider Networks – Ideal for ISP and telecommunications infrastructure

Why Choose the Cisco 1000BASE-SX Multimode SFP Module?

High-Performance & Reliable Connectivity – Ensures fast, stable, and energy-efficient networking
Seamless Multi-Brand Compatibility – Works with Cisco and other major networking brands
Advanced Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) – Allows real-time performance tracking
Plug & Play, Hot-Swappable Design – Enables quick deployment and upgrades
Cost-Effective Solution – Provides affordable, high-speed fiber-optic networking
